title: First-principles investigation and photovoltaic assessment of Cs2SnZ6 (Z = Cl, Br, I) lead-free perovskites for future solar technologies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26515-26536
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03487F, Paper

Md. Ferdous Rahman, Abu Saiyed, Md. Faruk Hossain, Latha Marasamy, Tanvir Al Galib, Mahabur Rahman, Mutasem Z. Bani-Fwaz
This study explores the structural, electronic, optical, and photovoltaic properties of lead-free vacancy-ordered perovskites Cs2SnZ6 (Z = Cl, Br, I) via first-principles and device-level methods for next-generation solar energy applications.
